question: Should instruction-aware embedding query formatting become a public memorySearch configuration and Plugin SDK contract, or remain an internal/provider-owned capability?
rationale: Both directions are technically viable, but the choice establishes a new user configuration and external plugin API surface that repository policy treats as a long-term product and compatibility commitment.

options.title: Keep the seam provider-owned
options.body: Preserve the opt-in behavior but avoid exporting the model-family boolean and helper as broad permanent Plugin SDK surface unless an external plugin contract demonstrably needs them.

options.title: Approve the public contract
options.body: Accept queryInstructionTemplate and applyQueryInstructionTemplate as supported public APIs after restoring guidance and proving fresh-install, disabled, and enabled behavior.

options.title: Retain raw OpenAI behavior
options.body: Decline the new option and leave model-specific prompt formatting to endpoint configuration or provider-specific integrations.

recommendation.title: Keep the seam provider-owned
recommendation.body: Preserve the opt-in behavior but avoid exporting the model-family boolean and helper as broad permanent Plugin SDK surface unless an external plugin contract demonstrably needs them.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent history is most closely connected to the OpenAI embedding-provider architecture and provider ownership boundary affected by this choice.
